title: BudgetCreate
description: Body of POST /budgets. Unknown keys are a 422. `scope_type` and `scope_id` may be changed later by PATCH; the currency is fixed.

scope_type.description: What the budget watches. `api_key` budgets alert but cannot be hard-blocked at the gateway.

scope_id.description: Public id of the workspace (`ws_…`), project (`proj_…`) or API key (`key_…`) in `scope_type`, in this organisation. Must be null for `organisation`.

period.description: Calendar month (UTC) or Monday–Sunday week (UTC). Default `monthly`.

amount_cents.description: Cap in US cents (minor units), 1 to 100,000,000. Never a decimal.

alert_threshold_pct.description: Percentage of the cap at which the warning email is sent. Default 80.

hard_block.description: When true the gateway refuses requests once the cap is exceeded; otherwise alert only. Default false. Applied on the next budgets evaluation pass, not instantly. Sending true with scope_type `api_key` is a 422 validation_failed on hard_block (that scope can only alert).

enabled.description: Absent = true on create, unchanged on update or replace. Boolean only: null is a 422.

id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

currency.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

created_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

updated_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.
